entries.possibleCause: There is a break in the power supply.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check the household fuse box and replace a blown household fuse if appropriate.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the oven still does not work after the household power supply and fuse have been checked.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video showing that the oven does not operate
description of the household fuse check
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 79, OPERATION IN CASE OF EMERGENCY

entries.problem: The programmer display shows flashing 0.00 or 0:00
entries.possibleCause: The appliance was disconnected from the mains or there was a temporary power cut.
entries.safeUserCheck: Set the current time on the electronic programmer as described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required if the display returns to normal after the current time is set.
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 64-65 and 79, OPERATION / OPERATION IN CASE OF EMERGENCY

entries.problem: The oven cannot be operated because the current time has not been set
entries.possibleCause: After connection to the power supply or restoration of power, the electronic programmer requires the current time to be set before the oven can operate.
entries.safeUserCheck: Set the current time using the electronic programmer controls as described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required if the oven operates normally after the clock is set.
matchTerms: oven won't work after power cut
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 64-65, OPERATION - Before using the oven for the first time / Electronic timer

entries.problem: The oven lighting does not work
entries.possibleCause: The oven bulb may be loose or damaged.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the appliance from the mains before touching the lamp. Tighten or replace the oven lamp using the lamp replacement procedure described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the oven light still does not work after the supported lamp check or replacement.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video showing the lighting problem
description of the lamp check or replacement
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 75 and 79, CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE - Replacing the halogen bulb in the oven / OPERATION IN CASE OF EMERGENCY

entries.problem: The oven halogen bulb requires replacement
entries.possibleCause: The halogen oven bulb is damaged or no longer works.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the appliance from the mains. After the oven has cooled, follow the manual's lamp replacement procedure and use a G9 halogen bulb rated 230V and 25W.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal user-replaceable bulb replacement. Create a claim if the lighting still does not work afterward.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 75, CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE - Replacing the halogen bulb in the oven

entries.problem: The oven power supply cable is damaged
entries.possibleCause: The fixed power supply cable has been damaged. The manual states that it must be replaced by the manufacturer, an authorised service outlet, or a qualified person to avoid danger.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the oven. Disconnect it from the mains only if this can be done safely. Do not repair or replace the power cable yourself.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for a damaged power supply cable.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the damaged cable if safe to take
description of when the damage was noticed

entries.problem: The oven has a technical fault
entries.possibleCause: The manual does not provide a customer-repairable cause for technical faults.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the oven and disconnect the power supply. Do not attempt to repair the appliance. Report the fault to the service centre.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim whenever a technical fault prevents safe or correct operation.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video showing the fault

entries.problem: Hot steam escapes when the oven door is opened during or after cooking
entries.possibleCause: Hot steam can normally escape from the oven when the door is opened during or after cooking.
entries.safeUserCheck: Open the oven door carefully and do not lean over the door. The manual notes that hot steam may be invisible depending on its temperature.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal hot-steam release when opening the oven door.

entries.problem: An alarm sounds when the Kitchen Timer reaches the end of its countdown
entries.possibleCause: The selected Kitchen Timer period has elapsed.
entries.safeUserCheck: Touch and hold MENU or simultaneously touch and hold the < and > sensors to mute the alarm. If it is not manually muted, the alarm stops automatically after approximately 7 minutes.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for the normal Kitchen Timer alarm.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 65, OPERATION - Electronic timer - Kitchen Timer

entries.problem: The oven switches off automatically and an alarm sounds
entries.possibleCause: The programmed cooking duration has elapsed.
entries.safeUserCheck: Set the oven function selector and temperature selector to the off position, then mute the alarm using MENU or the < and > sensors as described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required when the oven switches off because the programmed duration has ended.
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 65-66, OPERATION - Electronic timer - Timed operation

entries.problem: A Kitchen Timer or timed-operation setting needs to be cancelled
entries.possibleCause: A timer or cooking-duration setting is currently active.
entries.safeUserCheck: For timed operation, simultaneously touch the < and > sensors. To cancel the Kitchen Timer, select the Kitchen Timer with MENU and then simultaneously touch the < and > sensors.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal timer cancellation.

entries.problem: The temperature regulator signal light switches on and off during cooking
entries.possibleCause: The oven thermostat cycles the heating to maintain the selected temperature.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required when the temperature signal light cycles on and off during normal cooking.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal thermostat cycling.
matchTerms: oven light turns on and off
red light goes on and off
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 68, OPERATION - Oven functions and operation

entries.problem: A heating function has been selected but the oven does not heat
entries.possibleCause: The temperature regulator has not been set. The manual states that a heating function only starts after a temperature is selected.
entries.safeUserCheck: Select the required oven function and then set the required temperature with the temperature regulator.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required if the oven begins heating after the temperature is set. Create a claim if it still does not heat.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the function and temperature control settings
description of whether the heating indicator illuminates
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 67-68, OPERATION - Oven functions and operation

entries.problem: The grill is being used with the oven door open
entries.possibleCause: The manual requires the oven door to remain closed when using the grill.
entries.safeUserCheck: Close the oven door while grilling. Accessible parts may become hot, so keep children away.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required when the grill operates normally with the door closed.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 69, OPERATION - Use of the grill

entries.problem: An oven fault remains after the supported user checks
entries.possibleCause: The manual does not provide a customer-repairable cause for faults that remain after the documented checks.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the oven if it has a technical fault. Disconnect the mains supply and contact an authorised service centre. Do not dismantle or repair the appliance yourself.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim when a fault remains after the safe checks described in the manual.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video showing the fault
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 57, 78-79, SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS / CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE / OPERATION IN CASE OF EMERGENCY
